messages:
maia: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — collecting Qs on hiring, org moves, and oncall impacts here.

arjun: Thanks! First Q — are we slicing headcount by product vs infra or by priority (growth vs maintenance)?

maia: We'll budget by function this cycle: growth (product), core infra (runtime/ops), and strategic (security/compliance). Not doing a strict grow/replace split.

lex: For the growth bucket, any rough PM:SWE ratio guidance? Trying to map pipeline for next quarter.

maia: Ballpark: ~1 PM per 3-4 SWE across growth teams. Teams with heavy research/product discovery may skew higher.

dana: Manager capacity is a concern — some teams already have 9+ directs. Are we funding more managers or forcing span compression?

maia: Priority is promoting from within where feasible and hiring a small set of senior ICs to reduce reporting load. We also have limited manager hires reserved for critical bottlenecks.

rebecca-people: Heads up: internal mobility will be emphasized. We'll publish a matchmaking spreadsheet next week and run office hours with hiring managers.

jules: Oncall question: if infra gets more headcount, will rotation frequency drop or will we keep existing expectations?

arjun: Expect rotation frequency to decrease for teams that take on dedicated infra hires. We'll update oncall rotas and SLAs once hires start landing.

sam-oncall-bot: system: rota draft uploaded — https://confluence.redwood/rota-draft (comments open) :eyes:

maia: Timeline: approvals this week; prioritized reqs go live next Monday. Q1/Q2 hires depending on offer cycles. We'll publish team-level commit dates by Friday.

lex: Any constraints on remote vs local hires? Legal/compliance sometimes blocks certain data-sensitive roles.

maia: Remote-first still, but roles touching regulated data may need local hires or specific contracts. Each req will indicate location constraints.

dana: If a manager proposes splitting a 6-person team into two 3-person pods, what's the approval flow?

maia: Manager -> Director -> VP review. If it changes headcount or budget lines, include finance and P&O in the proposal. Keep org charts and expected ramp timelines in the request.

rebecca-people: We'll run a leveling + promo workshop next month to align expectations for internal moves and to reduce friction.

maia: Thanks all — drop concrete team-level asks here or DM me. We'll track everything into the hiring tracker and share weekly updates. :thumbsup:
